hook.name: Bute
hook.description: A bonding-curve ERC-20 token (BUTE) that uses beforeSwap to intercept ETH-in swaps: it mints BUTE via a multi-factor curve (temporal decay, burn echo, peak bonus) and returns a BeforeSwapDelta, routing buys through the hook's own ETH reserve. Sell-side swaps pass through unmodified; selling BUTE is handled via a direct sell() function.
